workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots where BOTH are free (need 30-min meeting):

- Monday: 9:00-10:00 (9:00 or 9:30 start)
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00 (13:00 or 13:30 start)
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00 (15:00 or 15:30 start)
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30 (10:00 start only)
- Friday: 11:00-12:00 (11:00 or 11:30 start)

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these slots? Let me know which times work for both of them. I'll create the booking once we confirm all four are available.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, none of the proposed slots work for both Elena and David:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy during this entire period.
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy during this entire period.
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: Elena is free 15:00-15:30 but David has Partner lunch 15:00-15:30. Both busy 15:30-16:00.
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel), David is free.
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy during this entire period.

I also checked for other times when both Elena and David are free:
- Monday 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00
- Thursday 09:30-10:00 and 14:30-15:30
- Friday 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are both free during any of these alternative slots? If not, it may be that the meeting cannot be scheduled next week.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Thanks Brad. I double-checked Priya and Marcus's calendars against your alternative slots, and unfortunately none of them work for both Priya and Marcus.

However, I found one slot I missed in my original analysis: Tuesday 16:30-17:00. Both Priya and Marcus are free then. Could you check if Elena and David are both free Tuesday 16:30-17:00?

If that doesn't work either, we may have a problem. Let me know.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, Tuesday 16:30-17:00 doesn't work either - Elena has a Hiring panel and David has Travel during that time.

I've done a thorough analysis of when both Elena and David are free. Here are the slots where BOTH Elena and David have 30 minutes available:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00 (11:00 or 11:30 start)
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00 (09:00 or 09:30 start)
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00 (13:00 or 13:30 start)
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00 (09:30 start only), 14:30-15:30 (14:30 or 15:00 start)
- Friday: 10:30-11:00 (10:30 start only), 15:00-16:00 (15:00 or 15:30 start)

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars for ALL of these slots? If any of them work for both Priya and Marcus, we can book the meeting. If none work, we may need to report the meeting as infeasible.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

Priya & Marcus both free:
- Mon 9:00-10:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00, Tue 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00

Elena & David both free (per your analysis):
- Mon 11:00-12:00
- Tue 09:00-10:00
- Wed 13:00-14:00
